description.summary: inject multi-touch from a privileged remote-desktop client

protocol.description: Lets a remote-desktop host relay a viewer's touchscreen to the session as a real touch device: each created portal_virtual_touch_v1 is a wlr_touch on the seat, and its requests become the same down, motion, up, cancel and frame events a hardware touchscreen gives the compositor, so clients see wl_touch (and the compositor's own pointer emulation for clients without touch support). wlroots has no virtual-touch protocol; this is a labwc extension in the spirit of zwlr_virtual_pointer_v1.

description.summary: create a virtual touch device on the default seat
destroy the manager; existing devices remain

interface.name: portal_virtual_touch_v1
interface.description: Positions are given as x / x_extent and y / y_extent: a fraction of the area the device is mapped to (the whole output layout unless the compositor maps it to an output), as zwlr_virtual_pointer_v1's motion_absolute does. Touch ids are chosen by the client and must be unique among touches currently down. A frame request ends each set of simultaneous changes.

description.summary: the viewer lost the touch (e.g. a system gesture took it)
end of a set of simultaneous touch changes
destroy the device; touches still down are cancelled
